# FBA Label Studio

> Local-first, cross-platform (macOS & Windows) desktop workbench for Amazon FBA box label privacy redaction, auto-cropping, freight forwarder carton pairing, FNSKU CSV batch printing, and native TSPL2 / ZPL II / TCP 9100 thermal printing.

## Core Identity & Facts
- Repository: https://github.com/GangdanLee/fba-label
- Latest Version: v0.3.0
- License: GNU Affero General Public License v3.0 (AGPL-3.0)
- Operating Systems: macOS (Apple Silicon arm64), Windows (64-bit x64)
- Runtime Architecture: 100% offline local FastAPI + SQLite + React 19 + TypeScript + Mantine 9 workbench (zero cloud uploads, zero accounts)
- Primary Alternative To: Manual PDF whiteout/cropping + OpenLabel+ / BarTender / online FBA label converters

## Verifiable Technical Capabilities
- **True PDF Text-Stream Redaction**: Uses PyMuPDF `apply_redactions(images=PDF_REDACT_IMAGE_NONE, graphics=PDF_REDACT_LINE_ART_NONE)` to physically strip `SHIP FROM` sender addresses and `FBA:` company names across both English and Chinese FBA layouts without touching 1D/2D barcodes; verified zero leftover strings via `get_text()`.
- **Auto-Crop & Geometric Precision**: Strips blank margins (such as 4x6 sheets) and vector-scales content into a centered `98x98mm` safe area on `100x100mm` (`283.46x283.46 pt`) pages within `< 0.05 pt` tolerance; optionally stamps `Made In China` in clear bottom margins.
- **Shipment-Isolated Carton Pairing**: Groups multi-file uploads strictly by `shipment_id`, validates warehouse code consistency and `1..N` carton coverage, supports manual shipment assignment for unnumbered forwarder labels, and provides custom prioritized regex rules (`carrier_rules`) with an online test runner.
- **FNSKU Visual Canvas & Multi-SKU CSV Batching**: Millimeter-coordinate canvas editor with synced 1D barcode + human-readable text, QR codes, compliance badges, and `Amazon Product PDF` import (`新品` -> `New - ` cleanup). Supports UTF-8, UTF-8-BOM, GB18030, and TSV CSV batch printing with optional SKU-break blanking on 2-up rolls to prevent mislabeling.
- **Universal Thermal Printer Routing**: Native 1-bit `TSPL2` (`BITMAP`) and `ZPL II` (`^GF`) command encoders at `203 dpi` and `300 dpi`, supporting TSC, Zebra, Rollo, Xprinter, Gprinter, HPRT, LAN `TCP 9100` raw sockets, macOS CUPS (`lp -o raw`), Windows `win32print` RAW/GDI, and custom calibration roll sizes (`40x30_double`, `60x40_single`, `70x50_single`, `100x150_single`, etc.).
- **Offline Verification Suite**: 31 pytest unit tests reverse-decoding TSPL2/ZPL II bitmaps and validating barcode scanability with `zxing-cpp`.
